rationale: Entry: "Added `completions` capability to explicitly indicate support for argument autocompletion suggestions". The completion feature already existed; the change makes its declaration explicit (codebook DP5: tightens normative definitions), not a richer primitive (OTHER). A capability flag is how a party advertises what it offers (P3).
_meta is an extension point; the codebook puts extension mechanisms in P6, consistent with 2026-07-28#10 and 0.2-0.3#5 (P6). Coder 2 named P6 as the alternative.

Entry: "Update `ElicitResult` and `EnumSchema` to use a more standards-based approach" (SEP-1330). The stated reason is standards alignment of the schemas (DP5); the elicitation reshaping becomes the secondary code.

Entry: "Servers SHOULD return tools from `tools/list` in a deterministic order to enable client-side caching". The codebook lists "supports caching" under DP1, and 2026-07-28#14 (ttlMs/cacheScope) is coded DP1; the first code was inconsistent.

Elevate a2a.proto from being a gRPC-specific implementation file to the universal, normative source of truth: the change concerns the schema that defines the wire format across bindings (P1), not versioning, extension, deprecation or stewardship (P6). Coder 2 named P1 as the alternative.

change: tenant field: one endpoint serves many agents
rationale: tenant field added to all request messages; "Enables to serve multiple agents from a single endpoint". The change adds a routing field carried in every request (P1); it does not change whether interactions are stateful or how work is tracked (P2).
